responder:0796020a76c59964.reply: You can download any invoice PDF from the dashboard by navigating to **Settings → Billing → Invoice history**. Only workspace members with the Owner or Billing Admin role can see this section.

responder:d4de309b8bccc651.reply:
If your webhook endpoint has been returning errors for an extended period, Meridian will automatically disable it after 24 hours of continuous failures and will email the workspace Owners. You can view those failed deliveries in the endpoint’s Recent deliveries tab (kept for 7 days) and replay any you wish. Make sure the endpoint returns a 2xx status within 10 seconds; a non‑2xx response or timeout triggers the retry schedule (1 min, 5 min, 30 min, 2 h, 12 h) and after the final attempt the delivery is marked failed. Also verify the X‑Meridian‑Signature header as described, to ensure the request is accepted. 

Regarding the seats for the two members you removed: removing a member revokes their access immediately, but the seat itself is not credited until the next billing cycle, so you may still be billed for those seats until that time. Charges are applied according to your plan and proration rules, and the seat will be reflected in the next cycle’s invoice.

responder:dd737e8508dfc167.reply: On the Growth plan the REST API allows 600 requests per minute. If the limit is exceeded the API returns HTTP 429 with a Retry‑After header. Your client should respect the Retry‑After value and use exponential backoff with jitter rather than retrying on a fixed interval.

responder:e52089eee7abd73e.reply: If you cancel (delete) your workspace, the subscription is cancelled. Any remaining prepaid period is handled case‑by‑case and is not automatically credited. Additionally, downgrades do not provide partial credit for the unused portion of the period you have already paid for.
